name: vitisstudio/nativephp-firestore
description: Cloud Firestore and Firebase Authentication backed by the native Firebase SDKs.

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.Configure
bridge_functions.description: Initialise Firebase (once) and apply Firestore/Auth settings

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.Status
bridge_functions.description: Report whether Firebase is configured and with which project

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.GetDocument
bridge_functions.description: Read a single document

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.RunQuery
bridge_functions.description: Run a collection / collection-group query

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.Count
bridge_functions.description: Run a count() aggregation for a query

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.Commit
bridge_functions.description: Atomically apply one or more writes (set / update / delete)

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.TransactionBegin
bridge_functions.description: Start a native transaction session

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.TransactionGet
bridge_functions.description: Read a document inside a transaction session

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.TransactionCommit
bridge_functions.description: Hand the buffered writes to the transaction and wait for the outcome

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.TransactionAbort
bridge_functions.description: Abort a transaction session

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.Listen
bridge_functions.description: Attach a realtime snapshot listener to a document or query

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.StopListening
bridge_functions.description: Detach a snapshot listener

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.StopAllListeners
bridge_functions.description: Detach every snapshot listener

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.EnableNetwork
bridge_functions.description: Re-enable network access for Firestore

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.DisableNetwork
bridge_functions.description: Disable network access (serve from cache, queue writes)

bridge_functions.name: Firestore.WaitForPendingWrites
bridge_functions.description: Wait until all pending writes are acknowledged by the backend

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseAuth.SignInWithEmailAndPassword
bridge_functions.description: Sign in with email and password

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseAuth.CreateUserWithEmailAndPassword
bridge_functions.description: Create an account and sign in

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseAuth.SignInAnonymously
bridge_functions.description: Sign in anonymously

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseAuth.SignOut
bridge_functions.description: Sign out the current user

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseAuth.CurrentUser
bridge_functions.description: Return the signed-in user, if any

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseAuth.GetIdToken
bridge_functions.description: Return the current user's ID token

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseAuth.SendPasswordResetEmail
bridge_functions.description: Send a password reset email

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseAuth.Listen
bridge_functions.description: Start dispatching AuthStateChanged events

bridge_functions.name: FirebaseAuth.StopListening
bridge_functions.description: Stop dispatching AuthStateChanged events
